lessons: Ketika Rupiah terus melemah di tengah antisipasi kebijakan ketat dari The Fed, tetapi The Fed mempertahankan suku bunga acuannya, maka Rupiah menguat 0.083% menjadi Rp18.125.
Ketika IHSG diprediksi Bearish dengan confidence 62%, tetapi 61 titik unjuk rasa dan 17 kegiatan masyarakat terjadi di Jakarta, maka IHSG anjlok 3.49% ke level 5.098,06.
summary: The morning brief correctly predicted a bearish IHSG and stagnant foreign flow, but underestimated the severity of the market decline (-3.49%) and the widespread bearishness across all sectors, influenced by unexpected geopolitical concerns and local demonstrations, while the Rupiah strengthened contrary to expectations regarding Fed policy.
